title: Integrate approved City Moment, avatar and working-logo assets
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md and the referenced frozen docs/design sources. Rules Spec v1 is canonical: Repair/Sabotage each end at six, one direct player-card vote, private Route/Gate inputs and authoritative deterministic outcomes. The five-point/Witness/demo scripts and completed T01-T10 APIs are historical; preserve their existing tests/API compatibility without using them as new game rules. Edit only owned paths and use existing dependencies unless manifest ownership explicitly permits reviewed additions. Keep engine production pure and do not read credentials, provision services, deploy, publish PRs or start agents. Use original synthetic fixtures and verified assets only. Run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check; report outcomes and contract changes. Ingest the separately approved original twelve track-event assets and approved avatar/working-logo inventory through the registry. Include large transparent exports, legible small variants, accessible names and exact approval/provenance/digest records. Keep the working-name and working-logo status explicit without claiming public brand clearance. Source mockups remain composition references and do not become production assets automatically. Do not generate art or copy another game's identity in this coding task. Match the source icon titles and motion references without selecting a new palette or gameplay rule.
acceptance: Six Repair and six Sabotage assets resolve to their canonical City Moment names and semantic keys.
Avatar choices remain distinguishable at small sizes and do not encode a faction or reveal The Null.
Logo, avatar and moment assets all carry verified approval, original provenance and export metadata.
Unapproved mockups and missing masters fail validation rather than silently becoming shipping assets.
